summary: Scorpio Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Canadian foreign-private-issuer current report) announcing a sonic drilling and metallurgical test program at its 100%-owned Manhattan District Project in Nevada. The company engaged SLR International Corporation to evaluate already-mined surface material across four historic facilities—heap leach pad, tailings storage, waste dump, and low-grade stockpile—with roughly 35 sonic holes planned to test suitability for regional toll milling. No securities terms, board recommendation, advisor beyond SLR, or transaction mechanics are stated; results would advance to a Phase 2 resource estimate. Watch assay/metallurgical results and any follow-on toll-milling agreement as potential catalysts for a junior explorer dependent on equity financings.
